Marissa / Mina — forwarding Ben's note with attachments. TL;DR: Customer requests 30% off Hosted API for a 12-month commitment. Economics below: current list ARR ~ $1.1M after ramp; expected gross margin at 30% concession is tight but still positive given caching/batching profile. Key risk is precedent-setting for other mid-market accounts.

Why I think we should consider a controlled approval:
- Pilot is in a regulated vertical where a successful reference could unlock two enterprise deals already in late-stage pipeline.
- They are willing to prepay 9 months upfront and lock a two-region deployment which lowers our infra variability.
- They asked specifically for Redwood (not just cheapest model provider) — value around reliability, support, and rollouts.

Requested ask: Exec approval for up to 25-30% concession with the following guardrails:
1) Minimum 12-month term with 9-month prepay.
2) Commit to joint case study + technical reference within 6 months of go-live.
3) Discount tiers tied to usage milestones (20% base, additional up to 10% step-down at volume thresholds).

Thanks for the context. A few clarifying questions before I take this to the revenue leadership thread:
- Can you confirm forecasted annualized usage profile (tokens/day) for months 1–6? I want to validate the projected unit economics under heavy batching and KV cache assumptions.
- Legal: are there any requested SLA deviations or data residency asks? If so, list them.
- Is the customer asking for any IP carve-outs or model fine-tuning rights? That would push this to legal review and likely block a simple pricing concession.

Assuming no unusual legal asks and the economic model holds, I'm open to recommending a one-time structured concession: 22% starting discount with a path to 30% tied to the milestones Karthik suggested (prepay + usage ramp + reference). The rationale: preserves initial list pricing for other deals while creating a clear, measurable path for the deeper concession.

If everyone agrees, I'll draft the exec summary (one-pager) and send to Jonah + Mina for signoff.

Marissa
Head of Sales Ops

Team — reviewed the numbers and legal intake (no IP carve-outs, standard SLA). Economics look acceptable given prepay and regional consolidation. Approving structured concession as follows: 

Decision (exec-level approval from Finance):
- Approved concession: 22% off Hosted API list rate effective at signature.
- Conditional path to additional discount: up to +8% (cumulative 30%) if Neuromech meets both: (A) 9-month prepay on signing, and (B) sustained usage >= 75% of forecasted monthly tokens for months 3–6.
- Required: Signed MOP + joint case study commitment within 6 months; legal to include an expansion right (first negotiation window with 60 days notice) and standard audit rights.

Please document the agreed milestones in the SOW and ensure billing team sets up the prepay schedule. Ben — you have the go-ahead to present this offer; emphasize the conditional nature of the extra discount tiers.

Mina Haddad
Director, FP&A (Finance)
